$comment: Profile manifest read by install.sh. Declares what a profile installs so
the three profiles cannot drift into three copy-pasted shell flows.
Contract: nothing in `steps` may touch anything listed in `must_not_touch`.
install.sh --dry-run prints these steps without running them.
label: Standalone skills only
description: Agent skills for writing DataFlow pipelines by hand in Claude Code / Codex / Cursor. No MCP, no backend, no services.
audience: Users who want their coding agent to write DataFlow code directly, with no server running.
installs: Standalone skills (no MCP dependency) into a Claude Code / Cursor skills directory
The core_text operator reference the pipeline skill reads
does_not_install: Python packages (no pip install at all)
The FastAPI backend or MCP server
writes_outside_repo: The chosen skills directory only: ~/.claude/skills/<skill> (user scope) or ./.claude/skills/<skill> (project scope)

prerequisites.reason: runs the skill generator only; not installed into

steps.label: Render skills for Claude, Codex and Cursor from canonical sources
Copy standalone skills into the target skills directory
Install Cursor, Codex and shared agent assets into this repo

verify.label: Every installed skill has a readable SKILL.md
Codex and Cursor assets were generated

next_steps: Open Claude Code (or Cursor) in any project and run /generating-dataflow-pipeline
If the slash command does not appear, restart the agent so it rescans the skills directory
